description: The Indonesian Internet Service Providers Association (APJII), which also runs the Indonesia Internet Exchange (IIX) and the national domain registry IDNIC, carries out an annual survey to measure the development of the internet in Indonesia. The survey covers internet penetration, the number of internet users, the growth of penetration, user behaviour, e-commerce and business potential, and the survey site shows a map of penetration by province for the latest year. Editions are listed for 2013, 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 to 2020, 2022, 2023 and the current 2026 survey. APJII presents the results as an important source for government, academia and industry. Coverage: Indonesia, with provincial breakdowns. Format and access: reports downloadable from the survey site; a free download carries a watermark, while a premium download without watermark and with fuller content is offered, and a web map shows provincial results. Caveats: sample design, questionnaire and sample sizes were not checked; APJII's own description says it gathers data from its members, which differs from a household survey, and methods may have changed between editions. Simulation uses: provincial user and penetration figures for demand models and for weighting the population affected by outages. Related records: the ITU ICT indicators give comparable national series, and the Brazilian ICT household survey is a similar national survey.
licence: Not stated (free watermarked download; premium version offered)
